extraction.method: A single SIFT/RANSAC similarity transform registers extracted AI alpha to the original scan. AI alpha supplies ownership only; original source RGB is never warped, resized, strengthened or redrawn. Native continuous closed-form edge matting and foreground decontamination are solved in overlapping bounded tiles; exact original RGB is retained at opaque pixels. Original/white/dark visual review is required; alpha ownership remains approximate.

native_refinement.method: The reviewed AI alpha is registered back to the untouched original scan (137 source feature inliers, 1.78 native-pixel RMS). It supplies only complete leaf, stem, radiating petiole/hair and mask ownership; its invented left completion is excluded at the measured original slanted print boundary. The outer plate rule and neighboring leg are transparent. Opaque cream surfaces and all intrinsic engraved shading are original native RGB. No source pixels are warped, upscaled or redrawn; no anatomy hidden behind the actual print boundary is invented. Native two-pixel continuous edge matting preserves actual leaf/stem openings. The faded plate-rule rows use the inspected smooth original boundary instead of a threshold jump into the face.

extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied original engraved source crop. Extract ONLY the tall connected leafy botanical scroll rising from the hairy grotesque mask at its base, keeping the mask, all its radiating hair/foliate stems and every rising leaf together in their exact original positions. The crosshatched dark field is background, as are the straight external plate rule on the left, the neighboring person's leg on the right, the pale page and the unrelated debris below the mask. Remove these to actual transparency, including crosshatched spaces between leaves and stems. Preserve the original pale cream subject surfaces and all black engraved outlines, shading and hair/leaf hatching inside the subject; these are opaque artwork, not background. Keep the thin actual stems joining leaves and mask. Do not redraw, modernize, simplify, distort, change the pose, add hidden anatomy, repair original clipping at the left print boundary, or turn this into a clean modern illustration. Preserve the source's aged print texture and original proportions. Entire retained ornament visible with a little transparent padding; no straight border rule or detached printed background flecks.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Reviewed complete rising leaves, original thin stems, fan-shaped foliate/hair base and grotesque mask against the actual source, on white/dark and at native detail. The genuine printed left truncation is retained with the measured source boundary; rejected threshold jumps and invented AI left completion are absent. All delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unscaled source. External plate rule, dark hatch ground and neighboring leg removed; intrinsic print shading and cream surfaces retained.

assets.usage_notes: Independent native foliate vine with its mask base, kept together. The neighboring couple, crosshatched print ground, plate rule and caption are excluded. Only source-visible foliage and mask are retained, including the original artist’s truncations/occlusion at the neighboring figure. No new hidden hair, leaf tips, stems or portrait.
